breaking.change: Local light shadow maps now project casters' back faces in a single R32Float pass (matching directional cascades) instead of rendering front and back faces in two Rg32Float Woo midpoint passes. Single-sided thin geometry with side: "front" no longer casts local shadows from its front face alone.
breaking.fix: Set side: "double" on single-sided thin wall, plane, or foliage materials that must cast shadows from local point, spot, or area lights.
